wire.t: Jalen Hurts is expected to miss the rest of the season with blood clots in his lungs. He's on IR for Hurts So Good, which now has Tyler Shough and Geno Smith at quarterback.
Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and is out 6-10 weeks. He's on IR for Ceedees ships coming! 🏆, a 33-year-old receiver on a 3-3 team that owns one first-round pick in the next three drafts.
Lamar Jackson (ankle) is listed as out. Trevor Have I Ever starts Trevor Lawrence anyway, so this one only hurts the trade value.
Mike Evans left Week 6 with Achilles soreness and is listed as out. Mean Machine is 1-5 and doesn't own its own 2027 first.
Cam Skattebo was benched by the Giants in Week 6 and scored zero for I Believe in Love, which lost 85.14 to 75.38 in the ugliest game of the week.

Juwan Johnson played and put up a goose egg against the Giants. Bill_Buttlicker started him at tight end with George Kittle in the flex and DeMario Douglas (19.6) on the bench. Etn her out won anyway.
ChuckJ10 paid $200 of FAAB for Tyler Goodson and added Tyrone Tracy Jr. for free. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 now has more running backs than a youth league.
Marco_Polo paid $503 of FAAB for Dohnte Meyers in Week 4. Meyers has 3.2 fantasy points this season.

stories.title: TotesMagoat has won four of five titles, is 57‑9 in all-play, and owns three 2027 firsts
stories.dek: The champ isn't rebuilding, reloading or retooling. He's just taking everybody's stuff.
body: Lemon Squeezy is 5-1, leads the league with 1,054.12 points, and has a 57-9 all-play record. If TotesMagoat had played every team every week this season, he'd have lost nine times total. Only superdog91 is within 100 points of him.

That's not new. TotesMagoat won the title in 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2025, and lost the final in 2020 and 2023. superdog91 won the other three. Since 2019, those two have split all seven championships. The other ten of you are paying entry fees to a two-man league.

Here's the dynasty part that should scare you. The Pick Ledger says TotesMagoat owns ten picks in the first three rounds of the 2027 draft: his own first, G8rDuc's first, BertDirty's first, and five seconds. He also owns ChuckJ10's 2028 first. He got Jonah Coleman and that ChuckJ10 first for Kenneth Walker III in May, and Quinshon Judkins brought back BertDirty's 2027 first. Mean Machine is 1-5. That pick is looking very, very good.
Week 7 he gets Prepetente is the GOAT!, a 2-4 team that paid $503 for Dohnte Meyers. Somebody stop him. Nobody will.

stories.title: Young Love Hunters is 0‑6, 0‑66 in all-play, and owns eight 2027 picks
stories.dek: BeatULikeABoss has lost to every team in the league every single week. On purpose? We'll find out in the spring.
body: There's bad and there's 0-66. Young Love Hunters has the lowest score in league history (43.58 in Week 3), the sixth-lowest (54.88 in Week 4), and hasn't cleared 81 points all year. Jordan Love is the only reliable starter and he's averaging about 20 a week. Every other starter combined is averaging about 46.

But this is a dynasty league, and the tank has a point. BeatULikeABoss owns his own 2027 first, plus Marco_Polo's, Buccaneer51's and superdog91's 2027 seconds, plus four thirds. He also owns Bill_Buttlicker's and G8rDuc's 2028 seconds. His core (the top ten scorers on the roster) averages 24.3 years old, the youngest in the league.

The bill came due fast, though. BeatULikeABoss spent $500 of FAAB on Audric Estime in early September and dropped him in Week 5. He's 0-6 with a 3-17 record since joining in 2025. The picks are real. So is the losing.
Week 7 he draws Ceedees ships coming! 🏆, a 3-3 team averaging 155 a week. Enjoy the 1.1 overall pick, buddy. You're earning it.

stories.title: Five months later, who won the CeeDee Lamb trade?
stories.dek: In May, Bill_Buttlicker sent CeeDee Lamb to ChuckJ10 for George Pickens and ChuckJ10's 2027 first. ChuckJ10 named his team after it.
body: On May 24, Bill_Buttlicker traded CeeDee Lamb to ChuckJ10 for George Pickens and ChuckJ10's 2027 first-round pick. ChuckJ10's team is now called Ceedees ships coming! 🏆. Through six weeks, Lamb has 133.1 fantasy points and Pickens has 82.8. On the field, ChuckJ10 is winning by 50 points.

The standings say something else. Etn her out is 5-1. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 is 3-3, has given up a league-high 956.98 points, and sits fifth, right in the middle of the pack. That's where that 2027 first is headed right now. ChuckJ10 owns one first-round pick across the next three drafts, his own 2029.

And the roster is old. ChuckJ10's top ten scorers average 27.4 years old, with Dak Prescott at 33 and Davante Adams at 33 and on IR. Bill_Buttlicker's average 27.9, so he's not exactly young either, but he has both 2027 firsts.

Verdict: Lamb was the better player and the ship might still come in. But if Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 misses the playoffs, Bill_Buttlicker gets a high first for free. In dynasty, that's how you lose a trade while winning every week.

stories.title: Mean Machine is 1‑5, and tanking won't help: TotesMagoat owns the pick
stories.dek: BertDirty made the 2025 final. Now he's 1‑5 with the fifth-most points, and his own 2027 first belongs to the champ.
body: BertDirty lost the 2025 final to TotesMagoat. This year Mean Machine has 808.20 points (fifth in the league) and a 34-32 all-play record, and still sits at 1-5. Only Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 has had more points scored against it.
The bad luck has receipts. Mean Machine lost by 0.94 in Week 3, put up 153.60 in Week 5 and ran into Lemon Squeezy's 214.96, and lost by 7.02 last week to a team that started a zero at tight end.

Normally a 1-5 dynasty team sells and points at the draft. Not this one. In March, BertDirty sent his 2027 first (and 2028 second) to TotesMagoat in the Quinshon Judkins deal. Every loss Mean Machine takes from here makes the champ's pick better. BertDirty does own RedDevil904's 2027 first, but Trevor Have I Ever is 5-1, so that one's headed for the back of the round.
There's only one move: win. Mean Machine gets Trevor Have I Ever in Week 7. Nico Collins, Zay Flowers and Luther Burden III need to show up, and Mike Evans is out.

feature.title: Week 6: Lemon Squeezy, again, and two teams that forgot it was Sunday
body: Trevor Have I Ever had the top score of the week, 168.84, and handed 50 Shades of Rae its second loss. Trevor Lawrence had 27.34 and Germie Bernard dropped 25.7 out of the flex. RedDevil904 is 5-1 and has won two straight. Remember that he traded away his 2027 first, second and third. He's all in, and so far the bet is paying.

Lemon Squeezy beat Young Love Hunters 167.80 to 71.34, the biggest blowout of the week. Christian McCaffrey had 30.7, Malik Nabers had 29.5 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba had 25.4. TotesMagoat also left C.J. Stroud's 24.98 on the bench, which tells you everything about that roster.

Etn her out beat Mean Machine 112.08 to 105.06 and moved to 5-1 with a five-game win streak. Bill_Buttlicker started Juwan Johnson at tight end (zero points) and left DeMario Douglas (19.6) on the bench. He has the fewest points against in the league (602.20) and a 33-33 all-play record. Lucky? Yes. 5-1? Also yes.

And then there was Hanging with Hernandez 85.14, I Believe in Love 75.38, the ugliest game of the year. Cam Skattebo got benched by the Giants and scored zero, Kenyon Sadiq had 2.2, and Ladd McConkey had 2.7. G8rDuc got 20.5 from DeVonta Smith and almost nothing from his other receivers. It counts.

past: Won't you be my Nabers (2023, runner-up)

He also owns ten 2027 picks in the first three rounds, including three firsts. The rest of the league should be very afraid of the spring.

teams.name: Trevor Have I Ever
body: RedDevil904 has never made the playoffs in this league. Eight seasons, zero trips, and he's 5-1. Trevor Lawrence, James Cook III and Matthew Golden are carrying it, and he had the top score in Week 6.
He paid for it: no 2027 first, second or third. If this team doesn't make a run, it's 'Rebuild 4.0' next year with no picks to rebuild with.

teams.name: Etn her out
body: Yes, this is the newsletter guy's team. Bill_Buttlicker is 5-1 on five straight wins with the fewest points against in the league. The all-play says 33-33, which is a polite way of saying he's been lucky.
The long game is better. He owns his 2027 first and ChuckJ10's, from the CeeDee Lamb trade. He's made the playoffs four times since 2020 and finished third twice, but has never reached a final.

teams.name: 50 Shades of Rae
body: Three titles, seven playoff trips in seven years, and 226.80 in Week 5, the second-highest score in league history. Josh Allen and Bijan Robinson lead a roster whose core averages 25.4 years old.
He also owns four firsts over the next three drafts and paid $602 of FAAB for Cade Klubnik, who's on the taxi squad. The only team with a real shot at the empire.

teams.name: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆
body: ChuckJ10 has 61 wins and seven playoff trips, and has never reached a final. Last year Dewy's Decimals went 13-1 and lost anyway.
This year: third in points, most points against, 3-3. The core averages 27.4 and he owns one first-round pick in three drafts. The ship is coming. It might be the Titanic.

The team is named after a quarterback who's out for the year, and the tight ends combined for zero last week. MakeItRains still has his own 2027 first and $984 of FAAB room. Buy a tight end.

teams.name: Chubb So Big I Waddle
body: The oldest core in the league (28.3), led by a 42-year-old Aaron Rodgers. RobMeyers has made the playoffs twice in eight seasons and owns every one of his own picks.
That's the good news: he hasn't traded the future away. The bad news is the present is 3-3 with a 26-40 all-play. Sell the vets.

He's been aggressive: $295 for Mack Hollins, $199 for Najee Harris, $210 for Zonovan Knight. Jared Goff and Chris Olave are good. Too much of the rest is on the injury report.

teams.name: Hanging with Hernandez
body: G8rDuc is 22-80 all time with zero playoff trips in eight seasons. Last year he went 2-12. He's 2-4 and has won two straight, which is a heater by his standards.
He doesn't own a single 2027 pick in the first three rounds and traded his 2029 first for Derrick Henry, who's 32. There's no tank option. Win or keep losing for nothing.

teams.name: Prepetente is the GOAT!
body: Marco_Polo is 16-32 all time and has never made the playoffs. Brock Purdy (138) is having a great year. Jayden Daniels (85.66) is on the bench.
He spent $503 on Dohnte Meyers in Week 4 (3.2 points). Owns all his own 2028 and 2029 picks, so a rebuild is right there for the taking.

teams.name: Mean Machine
body: Last year's runner-up is 1-5 with the fifth-most points in the league. Kyren Williams (119) and Joe Burrow (102.24) are fine. The schedule has not been.
His own 2027 first belongs to TotesMagoat, so losing only helps the champ. He does have RedDevil904's first. Win games.

teams.name: Young Love Hunters
body: 0-66 in all-play. The lowest score in league history (43.58). BeatULikeABoss is 3-17 since joining last year.
He has his own 2027 first plus three seconds and four thirds, and the youngest core in the league (24.3). It's an actual plan. It's just very hard to watch.

rumors.t: TotesMagoat's trophy shelf now requires a building permit. The county has asked him to stop winning until they can inspect the load-bearing walls.
superdog91 paid $602 of FAAB for Cade Klubnik, who is on the taxi squad and has scored zero points. Sources say he has the receipt framed above his bed.
Marco_Polo's $503 bid on Dohnte Meyers works out to about $157 per fantasy point. The league office has referred the matter to a financial advisor and a priest.
BeatULikeABoss has already mocked the 2027 rookie draft 412 times. In 408 of them he takes a quarterback and then trades him to TotesMagoat.
G8rDuc doesn't own a 2027 pick in the first three rounds and has started asking around about his 2030 picks, which Sleeper says don't exist yet.
RobMeyers set his lineup this week by asking Aaron Rodgers for advice. Rodgers told him to start his gut and stop eating seed oils.
ChuckJ10's team is called Ceedees ships coming! 🏆. Maritime officials report the ship is 3-3, taking on water, and has given up the most points in the league.
Bill_Buttlicker is 5-1 with a .500 all-play record and has been seen thanking the schedule-maker by name. The schedule-maker is Sleeper. It does not care.

trades.why: Bill_Buttlicker has four tight ends and is starting Brandin Cooks. MakeItRains has Tyler Warren out and got zero from his tight ends last week. Tucker has 81.5 points and LaPorta is 25.
RobMeyers has the oldest core in the league and should turn vets into picks. superdog91 has four 2027 picks and a questionable Puka Nacua. A second for a WR3 with upside is fair for a contender.

Love (118.36) is outscoring Dak Prescott (107.86), who's 33. BeatULikeABoss gets a 24-year-old receiver and another pick for a tank that already has eight. One-QB league, so Love's value is highest to a contender right now.
RedDevil904 is 5-1 and all in. Jones (70.2 points) is 31 and on a team that should be selling. A third is about right.
Buccaneer51 owns BertDirty's 2027 second, which could be an early second if Mean Machine keeps losing. superdog91 gets the healthier receiver this week (Olave has 116 points) and that pick.
BeatULikeABoss sends five picks to the guy who already owns ten for a backup running back with 32.8 points. The empire grows.
Marco_Polo is 2-4. Kelce is 37. Tate is 21. This is the opposite of dynasty.
The reunion tour. ChuckJ10 gives Lamb back for Pickens, and Bill_Buttlicker keeps the 2027 first anyway. Everybody's emotionally confused.

trying: 0-66 in all-play. The picks are nice. Win one game before the trade deadline so we know you're alive.
17-49 all-play and $503 on Dohnte Meyers. Marco_Polo, put Jayden Daniels in the lineup or trade him.
Fifth in points and 1-5. BertDirty can't tank because TotesMagoat owns the pick. Start winning.
gfy: Four titles in five years. Leave something for the rest of us.
5-1 with the fewest points against in the league and a .500 all-play. Enjoy it while it lasts.
Traded the entire 2027 draft for a shot at a first-ever playoff trip. Bold. Cocky. Deserved, so far.

columnists.name: Hugh G. Rection
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.name: Richard "Dick" Gozinya
columnists.bio: Press-box regular with a pocket square and a former linebacker's bedside manner. Blunt, polished, and always one sentence away from calling you soft.

columnists.name: Holden McGroin
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from the porch of a trailer with a laptop he calls 'the press credential' and gives advice anyway.

columnists.name: Ivana Humpalot
columnists.bio: Covers the league from the sideline with a media pass and a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

columns.title: TOTESMAGOAT IS RUINING THIS LEAGUE AND I CAN'T STOP WATCHING
columns.dek: Four titles in five years. Ten 2027 picks. Somebody do SOMETHING.
body: I've covered a lot of dynasties. I've never covered one this rude. TotesMagoat has won FOUR of the last FIVE titles. He's 57-9 in all-play. He has 1,054 points, 40 more than superdog91 and 124 more than anybody else. And he's not done!

You know what he did in the offseason? He traded Kenneth Walker III for Jonah Coleman and ChuckJ10's 2028 FIRST. He traded Quinshon Judkins for BertDirty's 2027 FIRST. Mean Machine is 1-5! That could be a top-three pick! THE CHAMP COULD BE DRAFTING IN THE TOP THREE!

And where is everybody else? superdog91 is the only one fighting back, with three titles and four firsts. RedDevil904 went all in and he's 5-1, I respect it. ChuckJ10 has seven playoff trips and ZERO finals. ZERO. Bill_Buttlicker is 5-1 and you all know it's the schedule.
TotesMagoat isn't a manager. He's a weather system. And I love it. I LOVE IT. Somebody beat him so I have something to yell about!

columns.title: BertDirty can't tank, so stop acting like it
columns.dek: Your first belongs to the champ. Every loss is a gift to TotesMagoat. Play football.
body: I watched the film on Mean Machine. 808 points, fifth in the league. All-play of 34-32. That's a .500 football team that's 1-5 because the schedule punched it in the mouth. That happens. What you do next is what matters.

Here's the problem. BertDirty sent his 2027 first to TotesMagoat in March for Quinshon Judkins. So every time Mean Machine loses, the best team in the league gets a better pick. You don't get rewarded for losing. The champ does.

So no selling. No taxi-squad excuses. Kyren Williams is a top-ten running back. Joe Burrow is fine. Zay Flowers and Nico Collins are starters. Put the best eleven on the field and go take it from Trevor Have I Ever on Sunday. It's a 2.5-point game.
Losing when you can't benefit from losing is soft. Don't be soft.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Five Dynasty Moves That Can't Miss
columns.dek: I've been doing this for a long time. Some of it has been in this league.
body: 1. Trade every pick you own for Aaron Rodgers. He's 42, which means he's seen everything. Experience doesn't show up in the box score, which is why he's averaging 17 a week.
2. Draft only players named Jordan. Jordan Love has 118 points. Jordan Addison has 34.2. Jordan Watkins has 11.2. Jordan Mason is on IR. That's a whole roster and a lot of synergy.
3. Copy BeatULikeABoss. He's 0-6, which is the same number as the number of titles TotesMagoat would have if he'd won two more. Think about it.
4. Spend $503 on a wide receiver nobody else wants. Marco_Polo did it with Dohnte Meyers and now nobody else has Dohnte Meyers. That's called a monopoly.
5. Never start your best quarterback. Marco_Polo has Jayden Daniels on the bench and has never made the playoffs, which proves you can't make the playoffs with Daniels starting either.

columns.title: Etn her out's 5‑1 is the luckiest record in the league, and I can prove it
columns.dek: Expected wins, points against, and why the commissioner should be nervous.
body: The all-play record tells you what a team would do against a random schedule. Etn her out is 33-33. That's .500, which over six weeks is three expected wins. Bill_Buttlicker has five. That's two wins of luck, the most in the league.

Points against confirms it. Etn her out has allowed 602.20 points, the fewest in the league and about 160 fewer than the league average of 763. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 has allowed 956.98. Same league, same season. One got the 0-6 team in Week 3 and one didn't.

On the other side is Mean Machine: 34-32 all-play, one more all-play win than Etn her out, and a 1-5 record. That's two wins of bad luck. The two teams played in Week 6. Etn her out won by 7.02 with a zero at tight end.
My model says Etn her out finishes 8-6 and the commissioner gets very quiet in the group chat around Week 11. My model also says I should have been a dentist. Both can be true.

exits.t: Cost $503 of FAAB in Week 4. Has 3.2 fantasy points. Reportedly wants out so he can stop being the most expensive mistake in the league.
superdog91 paid $602 for him in June and parked him on the taxi squad. Sources say he'd like to at least see the field before his contract is used as a punchline.
Scored 20.24 in Week 6 and the team still put up 71.34. His camp has asked for teammates, preferably ones who score.
Scored 19.6 on the bench in Week 6 while Bill_Buttlicker started a tight end who scored zero. He'd like a manager who reads box scores.
Sat on the bench for 21 points in Week 6. Two franchise quarterbacks on a 2-4 team in a one-QB league is a dynasty asset, not a lineup.

facts: TotesMagoat (4) and superdog91 (3) have won all seven titles since 2019. They've met in the final four times.
ChuckJ10 went 13-1 in 2025 and didn't make the final. TotesMagoat went 13-1 in 2023 and lost it. The best record has won it three times in seven years.
G8rDuc went 1-12 in 2020 and 1-13 in 2023. He's 22-80 all time and has never made the playoffs.
LAWRENCEndORDER (2022) and NixInTheStix (2023) both named their team "Wilson is a flop" and both went home after one season.
Bill_Buttlicker's 224.90 in 2024 Week 14 is the third-highest score in league history. The team was called Fire Sale.
